entities.summary: East India Company, a political institution in Mauritius during French Colonial Period (Île de France) (1715–1735). Grew from French East India Company and La Bourdonnais Governor 1735. Led to the emergence of Sugar Plantations and Slavery and Corsair Base and Napoleonic Wars.
